title: Vertical speed hold
summary: Hold a climb rate: the setpoint against the altimeter's rate of change, sent back by wireless.

notes.body: The [[part:Differentiator]] turns an altitude into a climb rate; the [[part:Remapper]] scales that rate into the 0 to 1 a thruster wants; the [[part:Adder]] mixes in the setpoint. Both ends are a [[part:WirelessTransmitter]], so the loop needs no cable to the rest of the ship -- one channel in, one channel out.
